What the audit proves

Original Axum 0.7.4/0.7 and Warp 0.4/0.4.2 dependency declarations, server features, Rust editions, selected bins and library compilation contexts remain unchanged. All tracked Rust/Cargo/lock/ignore/configuration inputs are copied from immutable Git blobs. The same adapter compares archived cf34dbaa with current source; the four qualified controls are unchanged. Every selected declaration retains its original baseline ID and coordinates. Cold, warm and revision graphs match within each implementation with actual import/symbol/router cache hits.

The module denominator covers all 14 original module declarations in the selected files; 1 resolves, while the others retain generation gaps. It does not measure all use/re-export imports. Framework-only original handler proof cannot certify general import or call binding. 8 automatic fallback candidates are excluded from the user registration denominator. 3 original static-service registrations are inventoried separately because their file-serving contracts are unreviewed. Query/body conversion, application execution, compiler validity, runtime behavior and population recall are unqualified.

Implemented source contract

Recorded tracing-attributes 0.1.31 with canonical tracing 0.1.44 preserves parameter-free original helper signatures and body reachability under the native empty instrument attribute. Original Cargo.lock owning dependency paths, feature activation and the generated canonical runtime delegate are required. Fields, parameters, const/generic functions, composed wrappers, unavailable providers and renamed-only runtimes remain outside this contract. Generated spans/subscribers retain conditions and general Rust calls stay opaque. Default Warp log and trace::request wrappers preserve original callback ownership, native path/method rejection and input Error while yielding one Logged/Traced Reply; native Reply/Send/Clone/IsReject and subscriber effects remain unreviewed. Recorded tokio-macros 2.7.0 with Tokio 1.53.1 emits a standard test attribute, allowing valid parameter-free unit-returning test functions to be excluded only from the recorded non-test compilation. Literal include_str supplies namespace-only proof without reading included contents. Native instrumentation, Tokio test codegen, standard test selection, Warp log, Warp trace and literal included text are read without target execution. All five original placey callbacks now bind conditionally; Q&A extraction references and all four qualified controls remain unchanged. The full 29-route denominator has four qualified pairs, 19 conditional bindings and six misses. Rust router version is 11; general import/resolver versions remain 6.

Recorded boundaries and next implementation

  • axum-plus: Four native route/handler pairs qualify. Nine original handlers bind with unreviewed custom query/JSON extractors. General imports remain opaque despite framework-only original handler proof. MongoDB calls and runtime configuration are unreviewed.
  • axum-course: All six explicit source routes are missed. Custom derives, state, authentication/response middleware, merge/nest helpers, static fallback and formatting remain opaque. The emitted conditional automatic 404 is excluded from source route recall.
  • warp-placey: All five original source callbacks now bind conditionally through the recorded parameter-free tracing instrument helper and native default Warp log/trace wrappers. Native Tokio test functions are excluded only in the recorded non-test bin context. Original included text is not read. Captured values, wrapper Reply/Send/Clone/IsReject bounds, generated instrumentation, custom placeholder types and static services remain unreviewed; no new qualified request pairs follow.
  • warp-qa: All five original callbacks remain conditional. The original state mapper at line 217 is a deferred extraction reference for each endpoint, with one ordered output slot. Native query/JSON/form slots preserve callback arity; state output types, captured Clone/Send bounds, CORS, recovery and request predicates remain unreviewed. No new qualified pairs follow.

Next: address remaining Warp custom state/CORS/recovery and Axum helper/middleware contracts, then rerun this complete denominator. Broad P9/P10 accuracy and native platform checks remain open.

Reproduce

Clone the immutable repositories listed below, then run node scripts/qualify-rust-broader-consumers.mjs --wrappers --axum-plus /path/to/plus --axum-course /path/to/course --warp-placey /path/to/placey --warp-qa /path/to/qa with each checkout at its recorded commit. No Cargo/rustc, macro expansion, target configuration, build script, dependency or application code executes. Implementation digest: e6aaeea1c4f0eea7a6535ecc74c074574ebd1519a6be9594b758a5e72f3d170b.
